page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.8xlarge is an x86_64 instance type belonging to the High Clock Speed server family, deployed on the KVM hypervisor. At its core, the server provides 32 dedicated vCPUs backed by Intel Xeon 6462C processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance integrates 256 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU allocation ratio. Hardware acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs included in the hardware profile.

Storage and networking specifications reflect an architecture reliant on external services. The instance features no integrated local storage, meaning that operating system files and data volumes must be attached via remote block storage. For networking, the platform provides a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps to support high-throughput data ingestion and distributed operations, while complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included with the standard allocation.

The 8 to 1 memory-to-core ratio paired with dedicated 3.3 GHz compute cores provides balanced efficiency for workloads requiring substantial RAM alongside fast per-core execution. The operational tradeoff is the requirement for network-attached storage for all persistence. The instance is suited for in-memory databases, large distributed caches, memory-intensive analytical processing, and enterprise application backends.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.8xlarge is an x86_64 compute instance from the High Clock Speed family powered by KVM virtualization. The configuration delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor clocked at 3.3 GHz. Memory capacity reaches 256 GB, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU ratio that accommodates substantial in-memory datasets. Hardware acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs included in the profile. Furthermore, the instance provides no bundled local disk storage, requiring persistence through external block storage solutions. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 32 Gbps, ensuring strong throughput for network-bound services, while public IPv4 addresses are not included complimentary. This architectural balance between elevated clock speeds and generous memory capacity positions the instance efficiently for workloads requiring both per-core execution speed and heavy memory allocation, including in-memory databases, enterprise caching systems, high-concurrency transactional processing, and memory-intensive ETL pipelines.
